'''Donjel''' is a soldier under [[Rodel Ituralde]] from [[Arad Doman]]. 

== Appearance ==
He is stocky with gray short-cropped hair. He has an eye-patch over his missing right eye.

== Activities ==
He has a permanently hoarse voice after someone tried to hang him when he was young.

He scouts the area where Ituralde intends to meet the [[Dragonsworn]] leaders under the [[White Ribbon]].
